svg.title: Identity — a fingerprint grown from the work
svg.desc: Kartikeya Yadav, AI/ML engineer and co-founder of Kovidam. A fingerprint whose 36 minutiae are his 36 public repositories, oldest at the core (Jun 2025) and newest at the rim (Oct 2026); a light pulse travels outward and lights each one in the order it was started. Named points: First commit (Jun 2025), Chakraview (Mar 2026), Kovidam (Apr 2026), JKY Terminal (Aug 2026), AEGIS (Sep 2026), ForgeSRE (Sep 2026), EraseOps (Oct 2026). I build AI agents that act — and prove it. AI/ML engineer and co-founder of Kovidam, an AI talent-intelligence platform. I build systems end to end: the model, the agents that use it, the backend underneath and the product on top. Architected, not prompted — real data pipelines, real evaluation, and a person in charge of anything that can’t be undone. Rules: Prove it worked — ForgeSRE checks recovery against thresholds; EraseOps rescans until nothing personal is left.; A human signs off — ForgeSRE stops before a production rollback; EraseOps waits for approval of one exact plan hash.; Show the source — The evidence console links every answer to the exact video second or PDF page it came from.; Run where the data lives — AEGIS runs on one machine with no outbound calls; JKY Terminal and my-localmcp are local-first.. 16.0 MB of code. Synced 2026-10-09 09:48 IST.
